# archcast

name: archcast
version: 0.1.0
language: Rust (edition 2024)
category: CLI / Architecture & Flow Report Compiler
backends: cpu-simd-rayon (default: memchr + wide::f64x4 + rayon + resvg/tiny-skia/gif), webgpu-hybrid (optional feature: gpu via wgpu WGSL compute)

## Purpose
Deterministic compiler between AI-friendly YAML/JSON architecture specifications and fixed-style visual deliverables (HTML with browser WebGPU/Canvas2D motion, standalone root-level SVG files, optional raster PNG & animated flow-pulse GIF) + canonical Markdown/Mermaid documents. Also reverse-extracts existing HTML+SVG overview pages into canonical YAML and Markdown.

## Commands
- `archcast render <INPUT> -o <DIR> [--format all|both|media|html|svg|md|png|gif] [--png] [--gif] [--gif-mode overlay|delta] [--scale <F32>] [--gif-scale <F32>] [--frames <N>] [--fps <N>] [--static-html] [--backend auto|cpu|gpu] [--strict] [--json]`
  effects: pure
  io: input=input-path, output_dir=output-dir
  outputs: <stem>.html (report-html), <stem>[-<diag_id>].svg (diagram-svg), <stem>.md (doc-markdown), optional <stem>[-<diag_id>].png (diagram-png), optional <stem>[-<diag_id>].gif (diagram-gif), archcast.log (log)
- `archcast extract <INPUT> -o <DIR> [--yaml-only] [--json]`
  effects: pure
  io: input=input-path, output_dir=output-dir
  outputs: <stem>.yaml (spec-yaml), <stem>.md (doc-markdown), archcast.log (log)
- `archcast validate <INPUT> [--json]`
  effects: read-only
  io: input=input-file
- `archcast init <OUTPUT> [--title <TITLE>] [--json]`
  effects: pure
  io: output=output-file
  outputs: <OUTPUT> (spec-yaml)
- `archcast info [--backend auto|cpu|gpu] [--json]`
  effects: read-only

## Spec Schema (v1)
- root: schema_version (1), doc_title, title, lead[], diagrams[], flow_table
- diagram: id, heading, note, svg_title, canvas_title, subtitles[], columns[], edges[], callouts[], warning, footer
- column: id, title, width (optional), cards[]
- card: id, title, accent (Tone), badge (optional), align_with (optional card id), lines[], subcards[], footer
- edge: kind (direct|bus|loop_left|bottom_route), from[], to[], label, bus_slot
- flow_table: id, heading, note, groups[] -> { name, tone, rows[] -> { action, trigger, version, version_tone, entry[], downstream[], note } }, hint

## Machine Call Contract
contract_version: 1
json_flag: --json
schema_command: archcast __schema
interactive: false
exit_codes: 0=ok, 1=runtime, 2=usage, 3=input, 5=partial
artifact_roles: report-html, diagram-svg, doc-markdown, diagram-png, diagram-gif, spec-yaml, log
sidecar_log: <output_dir>/archcast.log (for render and extract)
